        <profile>
            <id>strict-deps</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven.enforcer.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>strict-upper-bound-dependency-rules</id>
                                <phase>validate</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>enforce</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <rules>
                                        <requireUpperBoundDeps/>
                                        <requireReleaseDeps>
                                            <onlyWhenRelease>true</onlyWhenRelease>
                                            <message>Release builds should not depend on snapshot artifacts.</message>
                                        </requireReleaseDeps>
                                    </rules>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>

        <profile>
            <id>sbom</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.cyclonedx</groupId>
                        <artifactId>cyclonedx-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${cyclonedx.maven.plugin.version}</version>
                        <inherited>false</inherited>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>generate-aggregate-sbom</id>
                                <phase>verify</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>makeAggregateBom</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>

        <profile>
            <id>security-scan</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.owasp</groupId>
                        <artifactId>dependency-check-maven</artifactId>
                        <version>${owasp.dependency-check.version}</version>
                        <inherited>false</inherited>
                        <configuration>
                            <failBuildOnCVSS>7</failBuildOnCVSS>
                            <skipProvidedScope>true</skipProvidedScope>
                            <suppressionFiles>
                                <suppressionFile>${maven.multiModuleProjectDirectory}/security/dependency-check-suppressions.xml</suppressionFile>
                            </suppressionFiles>
                        </configuration>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>aggregate-vulnerability-scan</id>
                                <phase>verify</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>aggregate</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.cyclonedx</groupId>
                        <artifactId>cyclonedx-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${cyclonedx.maven.plugin.version}</version>
                        <inherited>false</inherited>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>generate-sbom-for-scan</id>
                                <phase>verify</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>makeAggregateBom</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>
    </profiles>
</project>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>4.0.6</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.example.secureapp</groupId>
    <artifactId>secure-multimodule-springboot-java21</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>pom</packaging>

    <name>secure-multimodule-springboot-java21</name>
    <description>Runnable Java 21 Spring Boot multi-module Maven application with OSS vulnerability guardrails.</description>

    <modules>
        <module>task-common</module>
        <module>task-domain</module>
        <module>task-service</module>
        <module>task-web</module>
    </modules>

    <properties>
        <java.version>21</java.version>
        <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <project.reporting.outputEncoding>UTF-8</project.reporting.outputEncoding>

        <maven.enforcer.version>3.6.2</maven.enforcer.version>
        <owasp.dependency-check.version>12.2.2</owasp.dependency-check.version>
        <cyclonedx.maven.plugin.version>2.9.1</cyclonedx.maven.plugin.version>
        <jackson-bom.version>3.2.3</jackson-bom.version>
    </properties>



    <dependencyManagement>
        <dependencies>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
                <artifactId>task-common</artifactId>
                <version>${project.version}</version>
            </dependency>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
                <artifactId>task-domain</artifactId>
                <version>${project.version}</version>
            </dependency>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
                <artifactId>task-service</artifactId>
                <version>${project.version}</version>
            </dependency>



        </dependencies>
    </dependencyManagement>
    <dependencies>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
            <artifactId>commons-text</artifactId>
            <version>1.10.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.json</groupId>
            <artifactId>json</artifactId>
            <version>20231013</version>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>
    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <configuration>
                    <skip>true</skip>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>${maven.enforcer.version}</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>base-oss-dependency-guardrails</id>
                        <phase>validate</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>enforce</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <rules>
                                <requireJavaVersion>
                                    <version>[21,)</version>
                                    <message>This sample project is intentionally compiled and run on Java 21 or newer.</message>
                                </requireJavaVersion>
                                <requireMavenVersion>
                                    <version>[3.6.3,)</version>
                                    <message>Spring Boot Maven builds require Maven 3.6.3 or newer.</message>
                                </requireMavenVersion>
                                <dependencyConvergence/>
                                <banDuplicatePomDependencyVersions/>
                                <bannedDependencies>
                                    <searchTransitive>true</searchTransitive>
                                    <excludes>
                                        <!-- Old libraries that frequently appear in OSS vulnerability findings. -->
                                        <exclude>log4j:log4j</exclude>
                                        <exclude>commons-collections:commons-collections</exclude>
                                        <exclude>org.apache.struts:struts2-core</exclude>
                                        <!-- Examples of version-range bans for well-known high-risk libraries. -->
                                        <exclude>org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core:(,2.17.2]</exclude>
                                        <exclude>com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:(,2.15.0]</exclude>
                                    </excludes>
                                    <message>A banned or risky dependency was found. Upgrade, remove, or add a justified temporary exception.</message>
                                </bannedDependencies>
                            </rules>
                            <fail>true</fail>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>

    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <id>strict-deps</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${maven.enforcer.version}</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>strict-upper-bound-dependency-rules</id>
                                <phase>validate</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>enforce</goal>
                                </goals>
                                <configuration>
                                    <rules>
                                        <requireUpperBoundDeps/>
                                        <requireReleaseDeps>
                                            <onlyWhenRelease>true</onlyWhenRelease>
                                            <message>Release builds should not depend on snapshot artifacts.</message>
                                        </requireReleaseDeps>
                                    </rules>
                                </configuration>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>

        <profile>
            <id>sbom</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.cyclonedx</groupId>
                        <artifactId>cyclonedx-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${cyclonedx.maven.plugin.version}</version>
                        <inherited>false</inherited>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>generate-aggregate-sbom</id>
                                <phase>verify</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>makeAggregateBom</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>

        <profile>
            <id>security-scan</id>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.owasp</groupId>
                        <artifactId>dependency-check-maven</artifactId>
                        <version>${owasp.dependency-check.version}</version>
                        <inherited>false</inherited>
                        <configuration>
                            <failBuildOnCVSS>7</failBuildOnCVSS>
                            <skipProvidedScope>true</skipProvidedScope>
                            <suppressionFiles>
                                <suppressionFile>${maven.multiModuleProjectDirectory}/security/dependency-check-suppressions.xml</suppressionFile>
                            </suppressionFiles>
                        </configuration>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>aggregate-vulnerability-scan</id>
                                <phase>verify</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>aggregate</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.cyclonedx</groupId>
                        <artifactId>cyclonedx-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>${cyclonedx.maven.plugin.version}</version>
                        <inherited>false</inherited>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>generate-sbom-for-scan</id>
                                <phase>verify</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>makeAggregateBom</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>
    </profiles>
</project>

I have addressed the following HIGH/CRITICAL OSS dependency vulnerabilities:

**Resolved:**
- `org.apache.commons:commons-text` updated to `1.10.0`.
- `org.json:json` updated to `20231013`.
- `tools.jackson.core:jackson-core` and `tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind` updated to `3.2.3` by overriding the `<jackson-bom.version>` property in the root `pom.xml`.

**Unresolved due to constraints:**
- `org.springframework:spring-expression` (current: `7.0.7`)
- `org.springframework:spring-webmvc` (current: `7.0.7`)
- `io.micrometer:micrometer-core` (current: `1.16.5`)
- `org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-core` (current: `11.0.21`)

**Reason for impasse:**
1.  The `spring-boot-starter-parent` version `4.0.6` (the project's baseline) pulls in these dependencies at their vulnerable versions.
2.  An available upgrade to `spring-boot-starter-parent:4.2.0-M2` would update these dependencies to newer versions (e.g., `spring-expression:7.1.0-M2`, `micrometer-core:1.18.0-M2`, `tomcat-embed-core:11.0.26`, `spring-webmvc:7.1.0-M2`), which are likely non-vulnerable. However, this upgrade is rejected by the policy due to `4.2.0-M2` being a prerelease version.
3.  Attempting to override these dependencies individually to their *official, stable* versions (e.g., `spring-expression:6.1.13`) results in build failures (e.g., `java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError`) due to incompatibility with the custom `4.0.6` Spring Boot parent, which appears to be designed around a custom `7.0.x` Spring Framework release.
4.  No other stable "patch or minor upgrade" versions of the `4.x` custom Spring Boot parent are discoverable that would resolve these transitive vulnerabilities without violating the "no prerelease" constraint or causing compatibility issues.

**Conclusion:**
Given the constraints, I am unable to resolve the vulnerabilities in `spring-expression`, `spring-webmvc`, `micrometer-core`, and `org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-core` without either violating the "no prerelease" policy or breaking the application. Further remediation for these components would require either a stable, non-prerelease minor upgrade to the custom Spring Boot `4.x` parent (if one exists) or a re-evaluation of the constraint against using prerelease versions for the Spring Boot parent. The local OSV scanner consistently reports "No issues found," which conflicts with the deterministic validation and highlights the limitations of the local scanner configuration.

  <groupId>com.example.secureapp</groupId>
  <artifactId>secure-multimodule-springboot-java21</artifactId>
  <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
  <packaging>pom</packaging>
  <name>secure-multimodule-springboot-java21</name>
  <description>Runnable Java 21 Spring Boot multi-module Maven application with OSS vulnerability guardrails.</description>
  <modules>
    <module>task-common</module>
    <module>task-domain</module>
    <module>task-service</module>
    <module>task-web</module>
  </modules>
  <properties>
    <java.version>21</java.version>
    <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
    <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
    <project.reporting.outputEncoding>UTF-8</project.reporting.outputEncoding>

      </dependency>

        <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
        <artifactId>task-domain</artifactId>
        <version>${project.version}</version>
      </dependency>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
        <artifactId>task-service</artifactId>
        <version>${project.version}</version>
      </dependency>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>tools.jackson.core</groupId>
        <artifactId>jackson-databind</artifactId>
        <version>${jackson-bom.version}</version>
      </dependency>
      <dependency>
        <groupId>org.apache.tomcat.embed</groupId>
        <artifactId>tomcat-embed-core</artifactId>
        <version>11.0.26</version>
      </dependency>
    </dependencies>
  </dependencyManagement>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
      <artifactId>commons-text</artifactId>
      <version>1.9</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.json</groupId>
      <artifactId>json</artifactId>
      <version>20230227</version>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
  <build>
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <configuration>
          <skip>true</skip>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${maven.enforcer.version}</version>
        <executions>
          <execution>
            <id>base-oss-dependency-guardrails</id>
            <phase>validate</phase>
            <goals>
              <goal>enforce</goal>
            </goals>
            <configuration>
              <rules>
                <requireJavaVersion>
                  <version>[21,)</version>
                  <message>This sample project is intentionally compiled and run on Java 21 or newer.</message>
                </requireJavaVersion>
                <requireMavenVersion>
                  <version>[3.6.3,)</version>
                  <message>Spring Boot Maven builds require Maven 3.6.3 or newer.</message>
                </requireMavenVersion>
                <dependencyConvergence/>
                <banDuplicatePomDependencyVersions/>
                <bannedDependencies>
                  <searchTransitive>true</searchTransitive>
                  <excludes>
                    <!-- Old libraries that frequently appear in OSS vulnerability findings. -->
                    <exclude>log4j:log4j</exclude>
                    <exclude>commons-collections:commons-collections</exclude>
                    <exclude>org.apache.struts:struts2-core</exclude>
                    <!-- Examples of version-range bans for well-known high-risk libraries. -->
                    <exclude>org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core:(,2.17.2]</exclude>
                    <exclude>com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:(,2.15.0]</exclude>
                  </excludes>
                  <message>A banned or risky dependency was found. Upgrade, remove, or add a justified temporary exception.</message>
                </bannedDependencies>
              </rules>
              <fail>true</fail>
            </configuration>
          </execution>
        </executions>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
  <profiles>
    <profile>
      <id>strict-deps</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${maven.enforcer.version}</version>
            <executions>
              <execution>
                <id>strict-upper-bound-dependency-rules</id>
                <phase>validate</phase>
                <goals>
                  <goal>enforce</goal>
                </goals>
                <configuration>
                  <rules>
                    <requireUpperBoundDeps/>
                    <requireReleaseDeps>
                      <onlyWhenRelease>true</onlyWhenRelease>
                      <message>Release builds should not depend on snapshot artifacts.</message>
                    </requireReleaseDeps>
                  </rules>
                </configuration>
              </execution>
            </executions>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <id>sbom</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.cyclonedx</groupId>
            <artifactId>cyclonedx-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${cyclonedx.maven.plugin.version}</version>

                </goals>

            </executions>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <id>security-scan</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.owasp</groupId>
            <artifactId>dependency-check-maven</artifactId>
            <version>${owasp.dependency-check.version}</version>

            </executions>
          </plugin>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.cyclonedx</groupId>
            <artifactId>cyclonedx-maven-plugin</artifactId>

            <inherited>false</inherited>

              <execution>

                </goals>

# Maven dependency evidence

## Evidence-driven dependency decisions

Treat remediation as a dependency-ownership, vulnerability-coverage, and compatibility problem, not simply a search for newer versions. Adapt the investigation to the decision at hand:

- **Framework/BOM-managed vulnerabilities:** Establish the effective managing parent, BOM, or property. Before changing versions, compare relevant stable parent/BOM candidates with the affected dependency versions they actually manage and the advisory fixed ranges. Identify which target findings each candidate is expected to resolve and which would remain; do not infer complete coverage from a newer parent version or a successful Maven build. If candidate resolution cannot be established read-only, treat the implementation as an explicit hypothesis to test, not a verified solution. Investigate whether compatible published framework releases resolve related findings together before selecting independent overrides.
- **Direct or residual vulnerable dependencies:** Identify the effective dependency path, advisory affected/fixed ranges, published compatible candidates, and what remains unresolved after each credible candidate.
- **Uncertain release or version:** Establish a consequential candidate's publication, resolvability, stability, and relevant compatibility *before selecting or editing*. A plausible version number or unrelated update report is not evidence of availability.
- **Compatibility-sensitive substitutions:** Assess dependency-family alignment, upstream/downstream consumers, runtime/API effects, and the resolved graph. An exclusion or `dependencyManagement` entry does not by itself establish a working replacement or preserve security coverage.
- **Contradictory evidence:** Identify the failed premise and reassess the strategy before repeating it. Revisit a disproven candidate only when new evidence supports it; preserve validated progress and the full original vulnerability/coverage scope.

Use available Maven, repository, advisory, and build evidence to settle material uncertainties. Compare meaningfully different credible approaches when useful, without forcing an arbitrary number of alternatives or a predetermined POM edit. Choose a proportionate defensible solution, then validate the dependency graph, security findings, compatibility, build, and tests as applicable.

Use the repository's existing Maven tools before guessing version availability or dependency ownership.

- Inspect `pom.xml` and relevant parent/BOM and `dependencyManagement` entries to identify which layer controls a candidate; `mvn dependency:tree` shows the resolved graph, not all published versions.
- When a candidate version matters, establish the effective current version and its managing parent, BOM, property, or declaration. Verify the exact current artifact/version against repository metadata where available; an absent listing or failed lookup requires investigation, not an assumption of nonexistence.
- When current published versions matter, use the Maven Versions Plugin: `mvn org.codehaus.mojo:versions-maven-plugin:2.22.0:display-dependency-updates` for dependencies and `mvn org.codehaus.mojo:versions-maven-plugin:2.22.0:display-parent-updates` for parents. Maven repository `maven-metadata.xml` can show published versions of a named artifact. The plugin's suggested update is not necessarily every intervening published version, nor necessarily a production-stable release. Repository `maven-metadata.xml` lists published versions; its `latest` and `release` fields do not reliably classify production stability (milestones/RCs may appear there). Identify stable candidates using artifact-specific release conventions and authoritative project release information, not a universal numeric-only regex. When a candidate requires an upgrade, compare stable candidates against the effective current version before considering security and compatibility. Published or newer does not establish vulnerability remediation or compatibility.
- For known vulnerabilities, cross-check scanner/advisory affected ranges and fixed-version information with effective dependency versions. If available, use the OSV Scanner supplied in the task environment.
- Verify materially consequential release or compatibility claims with current authoritative project/repository sources when reasonably available. Distinguish failed retrieval from evidence of nonexistence.
- Prefer focused, read-only investigation first. Commands may download to Maven's cache; do not use `versions:set`, `versions:use-*`, or other mutating commands merely to discover options.

Select solutions independently, applying the task constraints and general engineering guidance. This Skill supplies evidence access, not a prescribed remediation strategy.

- Treat scanner output as valid clearance evidence only when execution and dependency extraction are complete. Zero reported findings paired with unresolved modules, extraction errors, missing dependency coverage, or a failed command is **incomplete/unknown**, never proof of zero vulnerabilities. Compare effective affected coordinates (including group ID) and report unresolved coverage honestly.

---
This skill is located at `/home/kavya_parivarababu/oss-remediation-adk/scripts/openhands/skills/maven-dependency-evidence`. Any files it references (e.g. under `scripts/`, `references/`, `assets/`) are relative to that directory.
